network.title: Compare agencies
network.help_avg_delay: Typical lateness in minutes over the window; the dot shows severity.
network.help_on_time: Share of readings within the on-time threshold.
network.help_delivered: Share of scheduled trips actually run, per the static timetable — shows "—" when the agency's feed doesn't report cancellations.
network.help_samples: Number of delay observations behind the figures.
network.help_feed: Percent of readings dropped as implausible — high means a stuck or frozen feed.
network.help_freshness: Whether the figures include the latest ingested data. "Behind" means the precomputed totals haven't caught up yet, so the most recent days may be missing.
network.help_coverage: The date span this agency actually has data for within the window.
network.help_ridership_weighted: When a manually-configured ridership weight exists for this agency, pools each route's on-time contribution by that weight instead of counting every route equally.
network.help_vehicle_km_delivered: Share of the current schedule's planned vehicle-kilometers actually run — shows "—" when this agency has no shapes.txt loaded or doesn't report cancellations (see Service delivered).

measurementPoint.all_stops_all_observations: Average of every recorded departure at every stop.

dedupRule.latest_observation_per_stop_event: When a departure is reported more than once, the latest report counts.

overview.empty: No observations in this range. Try a wider window.
overview.concentration_explainer: Each route's share of total delay in the selected range. The Lorenz curve below shows the skew: the dotted diagonal would be a perfectly even spread, and the further the curve bows away from it, the more the delay sits with a few routes.

overview.service_split_explainer: Average weekday vs weekend/holiday delay across the selected range. The daily series below shows whether the gap is persistent or a one-off.

hint.title: How to read these reports
hint.ranking_body: : identify chronically-late or consistently on-time routes.
hint.trend_body: : whether things are improving or worsening over time. A rising line means delays are growing.
hint.heatmap_body: : peak times during the day. Compare commuter peaks against midday.
hint.dow_body: : day-of-week characteristics. Surfaces whether weekends run more or less punctually than weekdays.
hint.csv: CSV export lets you hand data off to Excel or BI tools.
